fix: Make the name optional so hashed ids never allocate: change the field to `pub struct SharedId(pub(crate) Option<Rc<str>>, pub(crate) u64);`, return `Self(None, hash)` from `SharedId::of`, and return `Self(Some(Rc::from(value)), 0)` from `From<&'static str>`. Equality and hashing keep the same meaning (no caller reads `.0`; it is only used as a Hash/Eq key in shared.rs and presence.rs). Each `.shared(..)` / `.shared_bounds(..)` call runs inside the user's build closure, so this removes one heap allocation per tuple-id per build.

Move the release gate in front of the lint pass so release builds never compute lints: change the signature to `pub(crate) fn report(motion: &Motion, child_keyed: bool)`, put `if !cfg!(debug_assertions) { return; }` first, then `for lint in lints(motion, child_keyed) { ... }`. Update the single caller at node.rs:1122 (`super::lint::report(&spec, key.is_some());`). Today `motion_widget` runs `lints(..)` on every `.motion(..)` build in all profiles and `report` discards the result in release.

Collect once into a Vec and dedup in place: `let mut props: Vec<Prop> = motion.states[at + 1..].iter().filter(..).flat_map(..).collect(); props.sort_unstable(); props.dedup();`. Prop is Ord (BTreeSet requires it), so the sorted unique result is identical without the intermediate BTreeSet allocation.
